result.commit_binding: Parent-designated delivery commit; local git object and build/granite23-batch.json sha/delivery_sha agree. Artifact logs do not independently embed a commit attestation.

abi.conclusion: EL7 artifact records GLIBC symbols no newer than 2.17 and no dynamic libstdc++ or libgcc_s dependency.
Ubuntu artifact is a distribution-specific build; GLIBC_2.34 and GLIBCXX_3.4.32 dependencies are recorded.

granite_assertions_in_frozen_source.evidence_class: Source assertions corroborated by passing cli_process log; values below are expected assertion values, not payloads recovered from these artifacts.

curve_shaper.raw_validation: Each retained raw word must have low byte equal to tier 0..4; high bytes are independently decoded as signed8 and must match the matrix.
curve_shaper.invalid_table_policy: raw_words is null and stored_offsets empty; partial read case retains words_read=2 only.

scalar.interpretation: Matched value and no-op succeed; clamped and discarded writes are acknowledged but fail verification.

mapping.failure_policy: Empty targets/core_slots and all 64 command_remap entries null.

limitations: No Granite per-command fixture JSON was saved; the original individual raw responses cannot be independently reinspected from these artifacts.
Runtime metadata explicitly records no hardware device and no register access. The recorded hosts are EPYC CPUs, not the requested 9950X3D.
Container userspace tests and the host 7.0.0-1017-azure kernel do not demonstrate EL7 kernel-module compatibility.

local_analysis_tests.resolved_error: The bounded Intel TVB emulator hit a time/instruction boundary on Windows; its isolated recheck passed with unchanged code. All 142 analysis tests passed in cloud.

files.observation: Viewed the original PNG. Explicit version 0x00620205, presence 3, masks 0/81 and SMT On are visible. The scrollable table distinguishes fixed PM slots from sparse command indexes; slot 8 shows indexes 0/1 and coordinates 32/33. The footer states two PM CCD slots, one command target, two enabled core slots and no physical/APIC/OS binding or setting command. Lower rows require scrolling; the screenshot is not a full sixteen-row table view.

Viewed the original PNG. Granite 98.84.0, requested multiplier 5, previous raw 0x3F800000 and readback 0x40A00000 are readable, with Matched and the physical voltage/power/stability limitation visible. All five result rows and footer fit.

Viewed the original PNG. PPT request 350 W and reply 0x00000001 are readable. Effective limit readback says Unavailable / not verified; the footer repeats the acknowledgement-only boundary. All four result rows fit.

Viewed the original PNG. Requested Enabled, mode flag Enabled, Mode bit matches, and capability 0x00000007 / 0x00010007 are visible. The footer wraps without clipping and does not verify frequency, voltage, stability or other defaults.

Viewed the original PNG. All-core request -50 is labeled a count. Firmware acceptance and raw reply are shown alongside unavailable per-core readback and unknown affected physical core count. All six rows and the footer are visible.

Viewed the original PNG. All five tiers, fifteen signed counts including -128/127, and five uppercase packed words are visible. The first raw word is 0xFFCE8000. The footer reports five of five words, matching capabilities, read-only operation, unverified anchors/baseline/effects, and No write prepared; it wraps without clipping.

Viewed the original Qt6 PNG. All eighteen internal-clock rows from SMNCLK to MPDMA_PM_CLK_EFF fit, with stored values 24.5 through 33. Unit and Status remain unverified, the scaled-clock column has dashes, and the final raw word/offset 0x42040000 / 0x00000290 plus the offline footer are visible. This confirms the resized test viewport without dropping its full-visibility assertion.

observations: The actual 1200x760 PNG was opened with view_image at original detail. The offline SMU 98.84.0 notice, explicit inputs, seven table headers and bottom limitation text are readable.

Visible inputs are table 0x00620205, presence 3, target 0 mask 0, target 1 mask 81, SMT On. The visible target 0 rows are disabled by input. PM slot 8 is target 1/core bit 0, enabled, with command indexes 0,1 and encoded coordinates 32,33.

The viewport fully shows PM slots 0 through 11 and only part of slot 12. Its vertical scrollbar is visible; rows 13 through 15 are below the captured viewport. This image does not visually establish the final enabled slot 15 or complete sixteen-row table.

The footer reports two PM CCD slots, one command target and two enabled core slots, explicitly caller-supplied inputs, no live or physical CCD/APIC/OS CPU binding, sibling aliasing and no generated setting command. These labels do not equate firmware coordinates with physical identities.
The actual 1400x1250 PNG was opened with view_image at original detail. All five result rows, the Granite Ridge SMU 98.84.0 platform selection and the bottom status fit and are readable.
The result shows previous raw 0x3F800000, readback raw 0x40A00000, multiplier 5, Firmware accepted and Matched. The hexadecimal words are fully visible with uppercase digits.

The footer scopes success to firmware readback and states that physical voltage, power and stability are not measured; it requests a new read before another edit. It does not claim an observed electrical effect.
The actual 1400x1250 PNG was opened with view_image at original detail. The selected PPT/W control, value 350, all four result rows and bottom limitation text are visible.
The table shows Requested ppt (W) 350, Firmware accepted, response 0x00000001, and Effective limit readback Unavailable / not verified.
The footer says the firmware accepted ppt = 350 W while the effective limit remains unverified. No current limit or physical power measurement is displayed.
The actual 1400x1250 PNG was opened with view_image at original detail. All five result rows and the two-line footer fit without cutoff.
The result shows requested Enabled, Firmware accepted, mode flag readback Enabled, Mode bit matches, and capability before / after 0x00000007 / 0x00010007.
The footer limits verification to the manual-OC mode flag and leaves frequency, voltage, stability and restored defaults unverified. The unchanged frequency input is not presented as measured state.
The actual 1400x1250 PNG was opened with view_image at original detail. All six result rows and bottom status are visible.
The table displays Firmware all cores scope, requested CO count -50, Firmware accepted, response 0x00000001, per-core readback Unavailable / not verified, and affected physical core count Unknown.
The result uses CO counts and an acknowledgement-only claim. It does not identify physical cores, report a verified per-core setting, or label the count as millivolts.
The actual 1400x1350 PNG was opened with view_image at original detail. All five frequency-tier rows, three count columns, packed-word column and complete bottom limitations are readable and fit.

Tier 0 displays -128,-50,-1 / 0xFFCE8000; tier 1 displays 0,1,30 / 0x1E010001; tier 2 displays 31,50,127 / 0x7F321F02; tier 3 displays -127,-2,29 / 0x1DFE8103; tier 4 displays 126,32,-51 / 0xCD207E04. All fifteen signed counts and all five raw words were visually inspected.
The status identifies CPU 130, exact SMU 98.84.0 / 0x00625400, 15 saved signed count offsets, 5/5 words and identical capability 0x00000007 before and after.

The footer explicitly says Read only and No write prepared, with frequency/temperature anchors, baseline-plus-offset combined counts and applied CO/voltage unverified. No guessed GHz/temperature values or Shaper write control is shown.
Original cloud PNGs were actually viewed by root and physical_mapping. No hardware acceptance is inferred.
Mapping views contain normal vertical scrolling: hidden rows are not counted as visually reviewed. Full mapping values have separate core/CLI/Qt assertions.
All five Shaper rows and their packed words are readable on EL7 and Ubuntu 24.04, including signed8 extremes. EL10 internal-clock rows and footer all fit.
